parsed.basis: Leiria is a mid-sized coastal regional capital in central Portugal whose visitors encounter the same national protections as elsewhere: discrimination on gender identity is prohibited, access to facilities matching gender is protected, gender-affirming care is lawful, and hate-crime aggravation applies, with no criminalisation of trans identity or presentation. Locally, Leiria is less cosmopolitan than Lisbon or Porto, with a smaller visible LGBTQ community and a more socially conservative, Catholic-influenced atmosphere, so an outed visitor may face more staring, curiosity and conservative disapproval and find fewer specialist services or community supports. There is no known Leiria-specific ordinance, enforcement practice or facility restriction diverging from national law, and police and courts operate under the national framework.
